cors.title: Can't read this image
cors.message: This site doesn't allow other apps to read its images. Download it and upload it instead.

network.title: Couldn't load this link
network.message: Check the link and your connection, then try again.

notAnImage.title: That's not an image
notAnImage.message: The link or file doesn't contain a picture. Use JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC.

unsupportedFormat.title: {{name}} can't be added
unsupportedFormat.message: Use JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC.

decodeFailed.title: {{name}} can't be read
decodeFailed.message: The file may be damaged. Try saving it again as a JPG or PNG.

tooLarge.title: {{name}} is too large
tooLarge.message: Photos can be up to {{maxMb}} MB and {{maxMp}} megapixels. Try a smaller version.

animatedGif.title: {{name}}: first frame only
animatedGif.message: Animated GIFs print their first frame.

export.unsupported: This browser can't make PDFs here. Update it, or use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
export.missingImage: An image was removed while the PDF was being made. Try again.
export.empty: Add at least one image to export.
export.failed: Something went wrong while making the PDF. Try again. If it keeps failing, try fewer or smaller images.

generic.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
